channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Brasil está prestes a passar os EUA como maior superpotência agrícola
item.description: Brazil may overtake the US as the world's leading agricultural superpower, according to a Financial Times projection highlighting agricultural performance under Lula's government. Leadership in global agriculture represents a significant milestone for the Brazilian economy. This position reflects the crucial role of agriculture in diplomacy and food production.

item.title: O que Lula e Flávio devem fazer para vencer a eleição? Analistas respondem
item.description: Lula and Flávio are closely matched in votes, with the smallest margin since the return to democracy, and will face off in the second round on the 25th. Each candidate employs different campaign strategies to win over new voters, focusing on issues such as economy, security, and healthcare.

item.title: Pesquisa presidente: semana terá rodada com Quaest, BTG/Nexus e Datafolha
item.description: The runoff race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) will see at least four new national polls released this week, including surveys from BTG/Nexus, Quaest, Datafolha, and Palver.

item.title: Saiba como estão Lula e Flávio nas pesquisas a 13 dias do 2º turno
item.description: The latest national polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in 5 out of 6 surveys for the 2nd round, with narrow margins between the candidates. Only the Vox Brasil survey shows Lula ahead numerically, within the margin of error. The runoff takes place on October 25th.

item.title: Lula teve maior votação percentual no PI; Flávio, em RR
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) achieved his best percentage performance in Piauí (70.99%) and his worst in Roraima (22.86%), while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) had his best result in Roraima (71.06%) and his worst in Piauí (24.09%). Flávio outperformed his father Jair Bolsonaro in every state in 2022, except the Federal District. Lula will face Flávio in the second round on October 25, 2026, after PL won 14 states plus Brasília in the first round.

item.title: Aparecida espera receber 500 mil fiéis no feriado da padroeira
item.description: The city of Aparecida (SP) expects over 500,000 faithful during the Our Lady of Aparecida festival in October 2026, with an estimated economic impact of R$ 3.59 billion. Archbishop Dom Mário Antônio emphasized the celebration should focus on faith, not electoral disputes, following fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dia das Crianças: 6.253 menores de idade esperam adoção
item.description: On Children's Day 2026, Brazil has 6,253 minors waiting for adoption, while 31,434 people wish to adopt, resulting in five applicants for every available child. Bureaucracy and the preference for young girls without disabilities hinder the adoption of teenagers and children with special needs, as shown by the case of former officer Carlos Hogendorp, who was adopted at age five and now volunteers in shelters. Specialists emphasize the need to shift preference patterns to reduce the lengthy waiting list.

item.title: Aldeia indígena que 'estreou' nestas eleições deu a Lula seu melhor resultado no RJ
item.description: For the first time in history, the Sapukai Indigenous Village in Angra dos Reis (RJ) held an electoral section and gave Lula his highest vote percentage in the state, with 96% (147 out of 153 voters). In second place, the voting section at the Federal University of Engineering in Niterói also favored Lula with 81% of nominal votes. These outcomes highlight the significant influence of the indigenous community in the local electorate.

item.title: Raquel Lyra: ‘Não vale tudo na política, e papéis das instituições estão confusos’
item.description: Raquel Lyra, reelected governor of Pernambuco, emphasized the need to unite the population and criticized political polarization and the lack of clarity regarding institutional roles. She stated that not declaring a vote aims to maintain neutrality and place the state's interests above partisan disputes.

item.title: Recorde de governadores eleitos no 1º turno amplia desafio de Lula e Flávio contra abstenção
item.description: With 21 governors elected in the first round, Lula and Flávio face higher abstention in the second round. The smallest candidate margin (1.87 points) requires mobilization in decided states.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: planos para o esporte opõem incentivo público e financiamento privado
item.description: Lula and Flávio present opposing sports policies: Lula advocates for increased public funding, including the University of Sports and expanded athlete scholarships, while Flávio pushes for private investment and proposes banning transgender women from women's competitions.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula propõem sobre o funcionalismo público
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes a 'scissor' policy to reduce the public service as part of fiscal adjustment, raising concerns about public competitions and civil servants. Lula criticizes the proposal, advocating for the appreciation of servers. Bolsonaro's campaign denied intending to end public competitions.

item.title: Para ala do PL, aposentadoria de ministros do STF é melhor que impeachment
item.description: A faction of the PL party proposes the early retirement of STF ministers like Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino as a 'more peaceful' alternative to impeachment. With the largest Senate caucus in 2027, the party aims to consolidate influence in the judiciary. The strategy avoids direct confrontation, inspired by Barroso's 2025 departure.

item.title: Voto de Lula para deputado federal não foi para Edinho Silva, presidente do PT e coordenador de sua campanha à presidência
item.description: Lula did not vote for Edinho Silva, PT president and campaign coordinator. The former president's ballot did not record votes for Edinho, who was elected federal deputy for São Paulo.

item.title: Além do Planalto: como a eleição para o Congresso pode afetar impostos, empresas e dinheiro público
item.description: The 2026 election for the Brazilian National Congress can directly impact the country's economy, particularly regarding tax reform, inheritance taxes, and the allocation of parliamentary amendments in 2027. The elected deputies and senators, who take office in February 2027, will play a key role in implementing and adjusting the new fiscal legislation. The Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) campaign has already expressed intentions to modify mechanisms such as the 'split payment,' which automatically separates taxes in business transactions.

item.title: Eleições: Niterói se mantém à esquerda, mas vê PL crescer
item.description: Niterói maintained preference for left-wing candidates in the municipal elections, with 125,231 votes for progressive contenders, but the PL led individually with Douglas Gomes elected as federal deputy. The reelection of Lula and Eduardo Paes reinforced the trend of progressive votes in the city.

item.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida: por que a santa envolvida em polêmica eleitoral é a padroeira do Brasil?
item.description: The law that canonized Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint on October 12th sparked debates about church-state separation in a secular country. In 2026, the saint's involvement in electoral controversies rekindled questions about religion's role in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Como Nossa Senhora Aparecida foi proclamada rainha e padroeira do Brasil
item.description: The image of Our Lady of Aparecida was found by fishermen in the Paraíba do Sul River on October 12, 1717, after a miraculous catch. She was proclaimed patroness of Brazil in 1930 and has been a symbol of faith, though recently involved in political misinformation. The saint remains central to the country's Catholic identity.

item.title: Memes sobre Lula e Flávio viralizam nas redes sociais logo após o 1º turno
item.description: Memes about Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) went viral on social media after the first round of the 2026 elections on October 4. The runoff is scheduled for October 25, with polls showing a tight race. AI-generated videos highlight the humor and polarization of the election.

item.title: Orçamento, 6x1 e mais: não eleitos ajudam a traçar o rumo de temas centrais
item.description: Non-reelected lawmakers will keep voting until January 2027, shaping the 2027 budget and the 6x1 work schedule PEC, whose impacts extend beyond their terms.

item.title: Autora do impeachment de Dilma lamenta derrota: “Por que não recebi voto?”
item.description: Janaína Paschoal, author of Dilma Rousseff's impeachment, lamented her defeat in the election for the Chamber of Deputies, receiving fewer votes than in the previous election for councilwoman. She questioned whether her loss was due to merit or communication failure, highlighting her parliamentary work and project studies.

item.title: Plenário do TSE decidirá futuro do “Exército do Lula” no WhatsApp
item.description: The TSE plenary will decide on the future of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel following its suspension and provisional reinstatement. Chief Clerk Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva questions the total suspension of the channel due to specific content and raises concerns about overlapping requests across different instances.

item.title: Fim da 6x1 tem semana decisiva com luz verde de Alcolumbre e pressa de Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre signaled support for voting the 6×1 workweek PEC, with debates and possible approval scheduled for October 13-15, just 11 days before the presidential runoff. The Lula administration pushes for swift passage, while the opposition, aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro, watches skeptically.

item.title: Exército do Lula x Tropa do Flávio: canais violam a lei eleitoral? Entenda
item.description: WhatsApp channels 'Lula's Army' and 'Flávio's Troop' are used to mobilize supporters and share campaign content during the runoff. Electoral law allows these communities but regulates the use of messaging apps for political purposes. The strategy aims to reduce abstention and fight fake news.

item.title: Contas que não fecham: plano genérico de Flávio Bolsonaro e gradualismo de Lula deixam dúvida sobre Orçamento
item.description: The positive reaction of financial markets to the first round of elections, with increased chances of an opposition victory, places the economy at the center of the second round debate. Flávio Bolsonaro's generic plan and Lula's gradualism create uncertainty regarding public budget management. The article highlights the importance of fiscal debate in restoring Brazil's economic confidence.

item.title: Nunes Marques ligou modo ‘tratoraço’ no segundo turno das eleições, dizem ministros do TSE e STF
item.description: Ministers from the TSE and STF assess that Kassio Nunes Marques adopted a more combative stance in the second round of elections, abandoning the balanced posture he had previously maintained.

item.title: Os novos planos de lançamento de ‘Dark Horse’, o polêmico filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', a biography of Jair Bolsonaro, had its release postponed to 2027 after being investigated by the Federal Police for irregular funding suspicions. Audio recordings of Flávio Bolsonaro asking the Bank Master owner for money to fund the production led to an inquiry at the Supreme Court. The case became a focus of weakness in Flávio's presidential campaign.

item.title: Judicialização dispara no TSE: processos contra Lula e Flávio já superam quase três vezes do que 2022
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) received 698 lawsuits involving the Lula and Flávio campaigns in the first round of the 2026 elections, a 165% increase compared to 2022. The campaign is marked by intensive use of the judicial system, including cases on freedom of expression and artificial intelligence, reflecting growing polarization and increased judicial involvement in the electoral dispute.

item.title: Juristas criticam decisão de Nunes Marques de derrubar canal 'Exército de Lula' e defendem que caso precisa ir ao plenário
item.description: Legal experts criticize TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the WhatsApp channel 'Exército de Lula', labeling it prior censorship. The rapporteur, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, reinstated the channel, emphasizing the need for the case to go to the plenary. Lawyers argue that suspending the entire channel exceeded the goal of combating disinformation.

item.title: Renan Santos critica Ministério da Prosperidade de Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's proposal to create the Ministry of Prosperity, questioning its public policies and associating the idea with entrepreneur Pablo Marçal's discourse. He also labeled Flávio's proposals as generic and criticized the possibility of influencers taking public offices, warning about the decline of Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira sugere que Lula tem “princípio de esclerose”
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) stated that a federal government minister called to apologize after President Lula suggested his political career had been 'buried.' During a campaign event on Paulista Avenue, Lula commented on Ciro's defeat in the Senate reelection race, attributing his remarks to the president's 'principle of sclerosis.' Ciro, who lost the reelection bid, is aligned with support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy in the second round.

item.title: Artistas são cobrados nas redes por silêncio no 2º turno
item.description: Celebrities face online backlash for not taking a stance in the 2026 election's second round, with critics accusing them of silence. Social media posts mock their lack of public support for Lula, citing figures like Selton Mello, Whindersson Nunes, and Vini Jr. The campaign includes questions about aligning with 'the rich' or 'the poor,' tying voting to social justice advocacy.

item.title: Nikolas usa vitória de Lula em presídios para “convencer” indecisos
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) cited Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) 72.6% of valid votes in prison polling stations to dissuade undecided voters from supporting the PT candidate. He compared voting for Lula to voting for someone who stole a phone. The data is from the first round and does not exclusively represent convicted prisoners' votes, as it includes provisional detainees, socio-educational adolescents, and prison staff.

item.title: Do K-pop ao palanque: Lula agradece aos fandoms em ato na Avenida Paulista
item.description: Lula thanked fandoms supporting his re-election during the March for Democracy on Paulista Avenue. He used K-pop and pop language to connect with young voters, highlighting participation from communities like ARMY (BTS), swifties, BeyHive, and Anitta fans. These groups organized collective actions, including pro-Lula posts and calls for in-person activities.

item.title: Ato de Lula em São Paulo ocupou 7 quarteirões da av. Paulista
item.description: Lula's rally on Paulista Avenue occupied 7 blocks, covering an estimated 65,177.42 square meters. The presidential security team restricted drone usage by Poder360 for accurate counting, following standard protocols. The PT claimed 1 million attendees without methodology, which is implausible given the available space.

item.title: Ato pró-Lula teve "situações de tensão", diz SSP-DF
item.description: Pro-Lula rally on Brasília's North Axis caused tension with reports of unauthorized vehicle stickers. Police intervened to prevent clashes, no injuries or damage reported. Protesters demonstrated against Governor Celina Leão.

item.title: Flávio e Nikolas convocam atos para a reta final em ao menos 14 cidades
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira called supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro to rallies in at least 14 cities. The schedule includes Vitória, Salvador, São Paulo, Manaus, and Belo Horizonte, with events on October 24th in Juiz de Fora and Rio de Janeiro. Flávio will face Lula in the runoff on October 25th.

item.title: ‘Bolsonarismo é um fenômeno democrático’, defende Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, defeated presidential candidate from MBL, argues that bolsonarismo is a democratic phenomenon, claiming it thrives under the majority electoral system. He denies authoritarian risks from Flávio Bolsonaro, suggesting Jair Bolsonaro is the main issue, and criticizes academic theses like those of Steven Levitsky on authoritarianism within democracy.

item.title: Meta atribui falhas em posts de Lula a problemas técnicos
item.description: Meta denied electoral interference, attributing content distribution issues from Lula's campaign to technical problems. The PT questions this explanation and accuses the platform of favoring Flávio Bolsonaro. The TSE ordered the company to provide detailed technical explanations.

item.title: Palmeiras provoca Corinthians após goleada no Brasileirão: "Paternidade"
item.description: Palmeiras defeated Corinthians 4-1 in the Brazilian Championship and taunted the rival with posts about 'parenthood', highlighting its positive record in the 400 matches between the teams. The win keeps Palmeiras in the race for the top spot, while Corinthians approaches the relegation zone.

item.title: Palmeiras goleia o Corinthians e segue firme na briga pelo título do Brasileirão
item.description: Palmeiras beat Corinthians 4-1 at home in the 30th round of the Brazilian Championship, staying in second place with 63 points. Giay (2), Alexander Barboza and Matheus Bidu scored for Palmeiras; Gustavo Henrique scored an own goal for Corinthians, who remain in 16th place with 32 points.

item.title: Mendonça manda CUT apagar posts que ligavam Flávio a milícias, aposentadoria congelada e fim do Pix
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the CUT to remove Instagram posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to militias and criticizing pensions, Pix, and education. Flávio's campaign claimed irregular electoral advertising on the union's institutional profile. After removal, the CUT published a new post highlighting the censored content.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leva campanha à missa da Padroeira e Lula fica no Alvorada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attends the Lady of Aparecida mass in Brasília, while Lula stays at the Alvorada Palace. The strategy aims to attract Catholic voters and counter criticisms about the patron saint title proposed by his spiritual mentor.

item.title: Mendonça proíbe Lula de impulsionar vídeo que diz que Flávio é contra fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE banned Lula's campaign from promoting videos accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of opposing the end of the 6×1 work scale. The decision responded to a request from Flávio's campaign, deeming it illegal negative propaganda. Lula has used the issue to politically attack the PL.

item.title: O que se sabe sobre o vaivém de decisões da Justiça Eleitoral sobre o canal de WhatsApp 'Exército de Lula'
item.description: Conflicting rulings by the Brazilian Electoral Court suspended and then maintained the WhatsApp channel 'Exército de Lula', managed by André Janones, following a lawsuit filed by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign accusing the channel of spreading misinformation. The court clerk Villas Bôas Cueva granted 72 hours for clarifications, but the TSE president Kássio Nunes Marques upheld the suspension for allegedly sharing offensive content against candidates.

item.title: Após ato pró-Lula, Flávio e Nikolas confirmam "bloquinho" na Av. Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira confirm a pro-Bolsonaro rally on Paulista Avenue for October 18th, responding to the pro-Lula event. The move follows a gathering of 1 million supporters backing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's reelection, where he emphasized democracy and reaching out to non-voting citizens.

item.title: Votantes brasileiros do Oscar pedem atenção internacional às eleições
item.description: Over 60 Brazilian members of the Academy responsible for the Oscars, including filmmakers Wagner Moura, Kleber Mendonça Filho, and Fernando Meirelles, signed a letter published by Variety calling for international attention to Brazil's presidential runoff election on October 25, citing alleged threats to democracy. The letter highlights concerns about electoral integrity and urges international investigations. The initiative aims to mobilize global opinion regarding Brazil's political situation.

item.title: PM relata depredação, tumulto e pichações em dispersão de ato pró-Lula na Paulista
item.description: During the dispersal of the pro-Lula rally on Paulista Avenue, police reported thefts, unrest and graffiti, with units remaining on site to maintain public order. The metro said it had no records of damage to nearby stations and emphasized security measures to keep passenger flow safe. Lula spoke to young people and seniors ahead of the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para Justiça Eleitoral investigar diretor da PF por beneficiar Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint with the Electoral Court requesting an investigation into the Director General of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, for suspected use of public infrastructure to benefit Lula. The accusation is related to the first round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE investiga Marçal e site de cripto por suposto apoio irregular a Flávio
item.description: The TSE is investigating Pablo Marçal and the website Brasil 22 Token for suspected irregular support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential campaign. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva accepted the request filed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidate for re-election. The investigation aims to verify possible violations of electoral rules regarding campaign funding and political advertising.
